name: call_routine_twice
description: Calls one other routine two times in succession and then returns, with no other work in the decompiled body.

name: mask_bitplane_block_rows
description: Ands each word of a mask table into four interleaved bitplane copies of the target block, row by row, clearing every bit outside the mask. The loop runs over forty rows of four columns.

name: wait_and_clear_eight_words
description: Counts down a short delay loop and then writes zero into eight consecutive 16-bit words starting at a base address held in the address register.

name: clear_eight_words
description: Writes zero into eight consecutive 16-bit words starting at a base address, then passes its parameter back unchanged in the return value.

name: write_column_bits_to_planes
description: Sets or clears one bit in each of two bitplane buffers for a column, using the next bit of a shifted pattern on every step through four planes. The bit position comes from the row and column arguments.

name: setup_plane_table_and_copy
description: Fills four table entries with offsets that step by one plane stride, stores the destination pointer, then copies a fifty-seven-longword block from a fixed source and nine words after it.

name: toggle_stored_value_state
description: Toggles a saved state: when the flag is set it restores one stored value and clears the flag, otherwise it stores a second value, sets the flag and sets a companion byte.

name: init_vertical_interrupt_struct
description: Fills a structure that points to itself and to a shared data slot, sets a status byte, then either records a previous handler pointer or calls a library function through a library base vector. The string xenon vert int is referenced nearby.

name: dispatch_interrupt_flag_handler
description: Checks a flag bit held in a global value and, when it is clear, calls two routines; when it is set it stores the flag value and calls a handler through a stored pointer. The routine's hardware references include the interrupt request register.

name: read_joystick_input_state
description: Reads the joystick movement register, the fire-button port and the mouse movement register, then tracks direction changes with a repeat counter. It also restarts the copper list pointer and jump register from stored values.

name: return_immediately
description: Consists only of a return instruction, so calling it does nothing.

name: wait_for_state_byte_change
description: Re-reads a state byte in a loop that has an empty body, so it spins until that byte changes under interrupt or hardware control, then returns the input register value unchanged.

name: call_routine_count_times
description: Calls another routine once for each step of a 16-bit countdown started from the argument, looping until the counter wraps past zero, and returns the argument.

name: read_cia_port_pair
description: Reads two CIA port registers for the fire buttons and disk status, combines their low bytes into one 16-bit word, and stores that word in a state field.

name: generate_scaled_pseudorandom_value
description: Steps a 16-bit state word with a multiply-and-add, then scales the result into a range given by the caller using a division. The scaled value is returned in the low word.

name: append_byte_until_buffer_full
description: While a flag is set, stores one byte at the buffer pointer, advances the pointer and counts the stored bytes. When 650 bytes have been stored it writes an end marker, calls several routines and returns.

name: update_input_state_per_frame
description: Runs once per frame to read the button and direction state, advance an idle timer and dispatch through a jump table chosen by the low state nibble, then clamp and store a horizontal and a vertical position. The routine references the text PRESS FIRE TO PLAY and a data file name.

name: return_without_action
description: Consists only of a return instruction, so calling it does nothing.

name: set_status_bits_and_return
description: Writes a byte back unchanged, sets bits 2, 4 and 5 of a status byte at a fixed offset, and returns the argument with its low six bits set.

name: return_constant_four
description: Returns the constant value four and does nothing else; the decoder found it in a gap between other routines.

name: exchange_word_block_buffers
description: Clears a state word and exchanges 512 words between a working buffer and a saved buffer, copying the saved values out and loading the working values in.

name: toggle_and_exchange_buffers
description: Flips a state word between zero and one, then exchanges 512 words between two buffers, with the roles of the buffers chosen by the new state value.

name: call_two_routines_in_turn
description: Calls two other routines one after the other and then returns, with no other work visible in the decompiled body.

name: run_four_blitter_passes
description: Programs the blitter with full masks, a fixed modulo and a fixed width, then starts four blits at successive plane offsets, waiting for the blitter to be free before each start.

name: advance_tile_animation_frames
description: Walks a table of animation records and, for each record whose countdown has expired, copies a block of words into four bitplane buffers and advances its frame index. It then steps two position values toward their targets and calls several routines.

name: call_routine_five_times
description: Calls another routine five times in a row and returns.

name: sync_shadow_state_bytes
description: Copies two state bytes into their shadow copies whenever they differ, calling a routine for each copy, and returns.

name: call_routines_with_fixed_pointers
description: Calls one routine twice with two fixed address arguments, then calls three other routines in turn and returns.

name: call_routine_six_times
description: Calls another routine six times in a row and returns.

name: adjust_clamped_counter_byte
description: When two status bytes are clear and a third condition holds, adds the argument to a counter byte and clamps it to the range zero to twenty-four. If the counter would go negative it calls a library function, sets a timer to thirty and calls a routine.

name: sync_bytes_and_decay_timers
description: Compares nine state bytes against their shadow copies and calls three routines for each one that changed, then counts two 16-bit timers down and clears their flags when they reach zero. While a timer is still running, a routine is called every 32 ticks.

name: emit_decimal_digits
description: Splits the value in a data register into decimal digits by repeated subtraction of descending powers of ten, starting at 100000, and calls a routine for each digit once leading zeros are passed.

name: emit_stored_decimal_digits
description: Reads a 32-bit value from a state field and emits it as decimal digits by repeated subtraction of descending powers of ten, calling a routine for each digit and one final routine at the end.

name: dispatch_digit_character
description: Converts a character by subtracting the ASCII zero code, optionally maps it through a lookup table, then calls one of two routines depending on whether the result is ten or eleven.

name: call_two_routines_in_order
description: Calls two other routines in sequence and returns, with no other work visible.

name: call_two_routines_sequentially
description: Calls two other routines one after the other and returns, with no other work visible.

name: emit_text_without_returns
description: Walks a zero-terminated text string and calls a routine for each character except carriage returns.

name: emit_text_skipping_carriage_returns
description: Walks a zero-terminated text string and calls a routine for every character other than carriage returns, stopping at the terminator.

name: update_cell_grid_and_objects
description: Clears a table of eight records, then fills a twelve-by-twelve grid of cells from a source buffer, scaled by 128. It then walks per-object records, advancing their animation counters and calling several routines to update their display.

name: run_blit_per_table_entry
description: Programs the blitter with full masks and a fixed modulo, then runs one small blit for each entry of a table, adjusting each target offset by a fixed amount and waiting for the blitter to be free before each start.

name: run_four_blits_unless_flagged
description: Unless a state byte equals one, programs the blitter with full masks and runs four blits at plane-stride offsets, waiting for the blitter to be free before each one.

name: run_four_blits_unless_state
description: Unless a state byte equals fourteen, programs the blitter with full masks and runs four blits at plane-stride offsets, waiting for the blitter to be free before each one.

name: call_routine_and_return
description: Calls one other routine and then returns, with no other work visible.

name: trap_if_flagged_then_run
description: Issues a trap instruction when a global value is nonzero, then calls three other routines in turn.

name: copy_four_plane_blocks
description: Programs the blitter with full masks and a fixed modulo, then runs four block copies whose source and destination offsets step by one plane stride, waiting for the blitter before each start.

name: call_routine_once
description: Calls one other routine and returns, with no other work visible.

name: call_two_routines_pair
description: Calls two other routines one after the other and returns, with no other work visible.

name: blit_rows_in_place
description: Calls one other routine, then runs a row loop of 192 rows that points the blitter source and destination at the same row, advancing 40 bytes per row and waiting for the blitter before each row.

name: fill_longwords_with_ones
description: Writes all-ones to a block of 2240 longwords that starts at a fixed offset from the address register.

name: call_two_routines_again
description: Calls two other routines in turn and returns, with no other work visible.

name: blit_fifty_six_rows
description: Runs a row loop of 56 rows that points the blitter source and destination at the same row, advancing 40 bytes per row and waiting for the blitter before each row.

name: return_unchanged_value
description: Has no visible effect in the decompiled body and returns its input values unchanged.

name: scan_neighbours_and_clear_flags
description: Steps through four neighbouring positions around a record, checks each in-range position with two test routines, and calls a handler when both pass. It then clears two status bytes of the record.

name: resume_neighbour_scan
description: Resumes the neighbour scan partway through its loop, using the caller's offsets, and clears two status bytes of the record when the scan finishes.

name: continue_neighbour_scan
description: Enters the same neighbour scan loop with the caller's offset and mask values, and clears two status bytes of the record when the scan finishes.

name: scan_neighbours_with_offsets
description: Runs the neighbour scan loop with offsets taken from the caller, calling test routines for each in-range position, and clears two status bytes of the record when finished.

name: clear_record_status_bytes
description: Sets two status bytes of a record to zero, at fixed offsets from the record pointer.

name: store_record_status_bytes
description: Writes three byte arguments into a record: one at offset twenty and two status bytes at offsets twelve and thirteen.

name: init_state_and_copy_positions
description: Sets a counter word to six, a state byte to one and another state byte to twenty-four, then copies two saved position words into their current position fields.

name: clear_state_and_copy_positions
description: Clears two state bytes and copies two saved position words into the current position fields.

name: update_object_screen_positions
description: Picks a speed value from the state, calls a routine with it, then either writes four screen position words from a lookup table or loops over object records, clamping each vertical position to the range zero to 198 and storing it with a horizontal offset.

name: blit_object_across_planes
description: Computes a screen position from the object's coordinates, programs the blitter for an object copy, and runs it across four plane offsets, switching between two blit configurations depending on the position.

name: set_flag_and_call_routine
description: Sets bit zero of a status byte and calls one other routine.

name: blit_object_planes_on_change
description: Computes a screen position and programs the blitter for an object image, skipping the destination reset when a stored value is unchanged, then runs four blits at plane-stride offsets.

name: jump_to_fixed_address
description: The decompiler timed out, so only the listed facts are known: a 147-instruction routine that makes four calls, reached through a single jump entry that passes control on to a fixed address.

name: spawn_object_into_mid_slots
description: Finds a free object slot in a middle range of a table, clears its ten words, and fills in its position and state bytes from a lookup table. It then runs a movement loop that calls two routines until the position reaches a limit.

name: call_and_mark_table_slot
description: Calls one other routine, then writes the value 255 into a table entry selected by a state byte.

name: spawn_object_into_low_slots
description: Finds a free object slot in the lower range of a table, clears its ten words, and fills in its values from a lookup table. It then runs the same movement loop that calls two routines until the position reaches a limit.

name: spawn_object_into_high_slots
description: Finds a free object slot in the upper range of a table, clears its ten words, and fills in its values from a lookup table. It then runs the same movement loop that calls two routines until the position reaches a limit.

name: clear_object_table_bytes
description: Zeroes 2200 consecutive bytes starting at a base pointer held in the address register.

name: call_routine_for_inactive_slots
description: Walks 60 object records at a fixed stride and calls one routine for each record whose second flag bit is clear.

name: call_routine_for_active_slots
description: Walks 60 object records at a fixed stride and calls one routine for each record whose second flag bit is set.

name: poll_routine_until_match
description: Calls one routine repeatedly until it returns the character X.

name: poll_routine_until_bracket
description: Calls one routine repeatedly until it returns the character left square bracket.

name: tick_timer_and_add_value
description: Clears a flag on an indexed record and counts down a per-slot timer. When the timer expires it calls a routine if a second byte is set and adds the record value plus one hundred, then adds the result into a 32-bit accumulator and sets a dirty flag.

name: append_record_to_list
description: If the record's top bit is clear, it counts the filled entries of a list, appends a new entry from a lookup table, and calls routines for each stored value. Otherwise it calls one routine and marks a list slot as empty.

name: queue_object_plane_blits
description: Calls one routine and clears bit zero of a status byte, then fills four blitter command blocks for an object at plane offsets that step by one plane stride, with the mode chosen by a flag.

name: draw_object_when_visible
description: When an object's row falls within the visible window, it programs the blitter with the object image, takes row offsets from a table and computes the destination address for the plane.

name: draw_object_four_planes_visible
description: When an object is inside the visible window, it sets up a blit from a row offset table and runs four blits at plane-stride offsets, with a shift chosen from the object's horizontal position.

name: draw_object_row_in_window
description: When an object's row lies in the window, it programs the blitter for a single row draw using offsets from a row table.

name: blit_object_planes_in_window
description: Computes a screen position from the object's coordinates and, when it is visible, programs the blitter for an object image and runs four plane-stride blits, with a shift chosen from the horizontal position.

name: register_pointer_and_blit
description: Adds a pointer to a table of up to 31 entries unless it is already present, then programs the blitter for a fill with full masks and runs three blits with a fixed control value, waiting for the blitter before each.

name: clear_global_and_return
description: Sets one global word to zero and returns. The decoder also lists the volume register of audio channel three as touched.

name: set_dma_channel_control
description: The decompiler timed out, so only the listed facts are known: a 170-instruction routine that writes the DMA control register and calls one other routine, and it is called from four places.

name: step_audio_channel_sequences
description: Walks a set of audio channel sequences by reading command bytes that set pitch, volume and jump targets, writing period and volume values to the audio channel registers and setting the matching DMA enable bits. It calls a routine for each flagged channel afterwards.

name: start_audio_channel_record
description: Loads a channel record from an input stream, then runs the same command-driven channel loop that writes audio register values and sets DMA enable bits for each channel.

name: step_audio_channel_loop
description: Runs the command-driven audio channel loop for each channel, writing audio register values and DMA enable bits, and calls one routine for each flagged channel at the end.

name: start_audio_channel_from_stream
description: Marks a channel record as active, copies its initial values from an input stream, then runs the audio channel loop that writes audio register values and DMA enable bits.

name: step_shift_register_bits
description: Advances two shift registers by one bit each, feeding in a bit computed from a masked global value, and returns a value scaled by four.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: The decoder reached bytes that are not valid instructions after a short counter update that clears two fields, so no clean behaviour can be recovered from this routine.

name: call_three_subroutines
description: The decompiler timed out, so only the listed facts are known: a 19-instruction routine that makes three calls and runs in the reference run.

name: apply_xor_run_length_patch
description: Writes return and jump opcodes into a scratch area, then walks a run-length encoded byte stream and XORs each decoded byte into a code address, advancing through the target region.

name: patch_code_after_library_call
description: Calls a library vector with a fixed argument set and returns early when it reports zero. Otherwise it writes return and jump opcodes into a scratch area and applies the same run-length XOR patch over a second code area.

name: return_immediately
description: Consists only of a return instruction, so calling it does nothing.

name: check_library_and_return_input
description: Stores the input character plus the ASCII value of one into a code slot and calls a library function. If that returns nonzero it calls a second library function and returns the input, and otherwise it returns minus one.

name: return_minus_one_high_word
description: Returns minus one in the upper half of the result while passing its parameter through in the lower half, and does nothing else.

name: store_char_and_call_library
description: Stores the input character plus the ASCII value of one into a code slot, then calls a library function through a library base vector and returns the input.

name: normalize_win_suffix_and_store
description: Compares a four-character value with the text WIN followed by a slash and changes the last character to a full stop when it matches. It stores the result and calls a library function through a base vector.

name: return_without_action
description: Consists only of a return instruction, so calling it does nothing.

name: return_immediately
description: Consists only of a return instruction, so calling it does nothing.

name: or_constant_into_word
description: ORs a fixed constant into one word at the address register, then the decoder reaches bytes that are not valid instructions, so the routine is bad data after its first instruction.

name: apply_xor_run_length_patch
description: Applies a run-length encoded XOR patch: from a stream it reads byte values and zero-run lengths, XORing each decoded byte into code at a base address derived from the routine's first input word.

name: set_color_then_apply_patch
description: Writes zero and a fixed value to a global, calls one routine, then applies the same run-length XOR patch to a code area. The decoder also lists the background colour register and the DMA control register as touched.

name: initialize_decode_buffer
description: Computes a buffer length from a shifted size field, clears that many bytes, calls a routine to decode data into the buffer, and zero-fills any space left up to the end pointer.

name: decode_lzss_stream
description: Clears a 4096-byte ring window, then decodes an LZSS-style stream: literal bytes are written to the output and the window, while back-references copy earlier window bytes using a position and a length.

name: compare_register_values
description: Compares two register values and returns in either case, leaving all data unchanged.

name: initialize_audio_channels
description: Clears a block of globals, then loads four audio channel pointers and lengths: each of the four channels gets the same sample address and a length of 16, using a table entry chosen by the input.

name: call_five_routines_in_order
description: Calls five other routines in turn and returns, with no other work visible.

name: decode_music_module_commands
description: Reads command bytes from a music sequence stream, handling restart, end, tempo and volume style commands and note bytes that index a frequency table, and updates the playback state for each channel. It also references a credits string naming the music authors.

name: update_audio_channel_registers
description: Waits until a global value equals the tilde character, then for four audio channels copies a pointer and length into the channel registers, or resets the channel to a default sample when a flag is set.

name: select_channel_sample_configuration
description: Selects per-channel sample data from global tables based on object state flags, copies eight longwords of sample configuration into a channel buffer, and sets the volume and period words for the channel.

name: check_flag_and_set_byte
description: Sets a status byte to one when a flag bit is set, a global value is nonzero and a counter word is zero, and to zero otherwise. On the successful path it also copies the global value into a RAM byte.

name: update_structure_from_table
description: Sets a state byte from a flag; otherwise it looks up timing words from a table using the nibbles of two source bytes, storing a default when a nibble is zero, and copies a fixed value into the structure.

name: advance_accumulator_phases
description: Advances a 16-bit accumulator by a rate value, converting it to a whole-number output in steps of one thousand. It switches phases when the accumulator passes a threshold of 64000 and sets the flag and output bytes accordingly.

name: scale_value_by_nibble
description: Multiplies a state word by four and by one more than the high nibble of a source byte, shifts the product right by six bits, and stores it in a state word.

name: initialize_channel_fields
description: When a source byte is nonzero, sets two fields from the nibbles of that byte, sets a mid-range level and clears a flag, then calls two routines. Otherwise it sets default values for the same fields.

name: step_level_toward_limit
description: Moves a level byte up or down by a step value until it reaches a limit derived from a second field, toggling a direction flag and calling a routine each time the direction reverses.

name: calculate_scaled_difference
description: Looks up two table values at an index derived from a source byte, subtracts them, multiplies the difference by a level from a state field, divides by 48, and stores the result in a state word.

name: adjust_state_counter
description: When one state word is not greater than another, counts a delay byte down and reloads it from a stored value, then increments or decrements a state counter kept within the range zero to fourteen.

name: extract_nibble_value
description: Takes the high nibble of a source byte, shifts it into a lower position and stores it in a state byte.

name: decrement_state_counter
description: Counts a state byte down by one while it is nonzero. When the byte is already zero it calls one routine to handle the state change.

name: initialize_timer_values
description: When a source byte is nonzero, derives a scaled threshold word and a counter value from its nibbles and sets a mode byte from one flag bit. Otherwise it clears the counter byte.

name: compute_clamped_sum
description: Adds several state bytes with a sign chosen by a flag, then stores the sum only when it lies within a fixed window. Otherwise it stores the value two.

name: decode_pointer_record_fields
description: Reads a record through a stored pointer. When its marker byte matches, it splits the nibbles of the second byte into fields and adds a base value to the third and fourth bytes to set two position fields; otherwise it clears the state fields.

name: update_progress_state
description: Advances a progress state using stored values and limits, stepping a level toward a target by a step value and returning the new level byte. It clears a flag once the target is reached.

name: compute_scaled_output_word
description: Selects an output value from a mode byte: in mode zero it copies a state byte, otherwise it accumulates a 32-bit counter in steps and stores the state byte scaled by the counter divided by one thousand, clamped at a fixed limit.

name: reset_counter_and_output
description: Sets a 32-bit counter to one thousand and stores the state byte shifted right by six into an output word.

name: configure_cia_and_interrupts
description: The decompiler timed out, so only the listed facts are known: a 33-instruction routine at the start of its segment that writes the CIA control registers, the interrupt enable register and the DMA control register, and calls seven other routines.

name: return_immediately
description: Consists only of a return instruction, so calling it does nothing.

name: dispatch_state_flag_bits
description: Checks bits of a global state value: bit four sets it to sixteen and returns, bit five calls one routine and sets it to thirty-two, and bit six sets it to sixty-four. Otherwise nothing changes.

name: wait_for_interrupt_flag
description: Spins until bit five of a global flag value is set, then sets the flag word to thirty-two.

name: set_global_high_byte_mask
description: Writes zero and then a constant with its high byte set into a global value, and the decoder lists the potentiometer-port register as touched.

name: return_after_zero_checks
description: Compares a global value against zero and tests its sign, then returns on every path without changing any data.

name: return_after_sign_check
description: Tests the sign of a global value and returns without changing any data.

name: return_immediately
description: Consists only of a return instruction, so calling it does nothing.

name: call_routine_on_carry
description: Calls one routine once, or repeatedly without end when the incoming carry flag was set, because the carry flag is forced to one after the first call.

name: read_keyboard_serial
description: Reads the keyboard serial data register, inverts the byte, stores the value shifted right by one in a global, and writes a table entry from the low bit. It clears the global when the low bit is zero.

name: process_joystick_input
description: Reads the mouse and joystick movement registers, the fire-button port and the potentiometer button register, converts the movement into signed deltas and button bits, and clamps the resulting position values to stored limits.

name: configure_cia_timers
description: Writes a sequence of constants to the timer, control and interrupt registers of both CIA chips, then writes the interrupt enable register with a masked value.

name: poll_until_result_zero
description: Calls one routine and, while its result is nonzero, sets a global to minus twenty and waits for that global to become zero before calling again. It returns once a call gives zero.

name: poll_until_result_clears
description: Sets a global to minus twenty, calls one routine, and waits for that global to reach zero, repeating while the routine's result is nonzero. When a flag is set after the call, it calls one routine in an endless loop and returns.

name: wait_for_global_zero
description: Waits until a global value is zero, then, while its input stays nonzero, sets the global to minus twenty and calls one routine before waiting again.

name: configure_ciab_timer
description: Writes a control value, the low and high bytes of its input word, and two further configuration bytes to the timer registers of the second CIA chip.

name: wait_until_global_clear
description: Spins until a global value is zero, then returns.

name: clear_flags_and_set_bit
description: Clears a global flag value when bit one or bit four is set, then sets it to 8192 and returns the input word unchanged.

name: process_interrupt_flag_bits
description: Saves a global interrupt status value and clears it, calls one routine if bit three was set, increments a counter when bit one of the saved value is set, and then sets the status to eight.

name: initialize_display_registers
description: Writes a sequence of constants to the display window, data fetch, bitplane modulo and copper registers, which the facts list as touched, and sets up the screen layout.

name: loop_forever
description: Loops forever with no operations, so control never returns to the caller.

name: trap_then_stop_while_flagged
description: Issues a trap instruction and then, while a global value is nonzero, executes a stop instruction that halts the processor until an interrupt.

name: return_immediately
description: Consists only of a return instruction, so calling it does nothing.

name: copy_block_header_fields
description: Copies words and bytes from a source block into global variables, sets one global from the input pointer plus a fixed offset of 512, and stores a value made by shifting a constant and XORing it with a mask taken from the block.

name: scan_entry_table_and_run
description: Searches a table of 63 entries for a matching record, computes a count from its fields, and calls one routine repeatedly while decrementing that count. It clears an output word if the routine ever reports failure.

name: return_immediately
description: Consists only of a return instruction, so calling it does nothing.

name: dispatch_on_nonnegative_result
description: Calls one routine and, when its result is non-negative, transfers through an indirect jump whose target could not be recovered. Otherwise it calls another routine and repeats.

name: verify_eight_byte_match
description: Compares eight bytes at a global address offset back by 512 bytes with eight bytes at another global address, returning zero when they all match and minus thirty-three otherwise.

name: compare_eight_bytes_for_match
description: Compares eight bytes at a global address offset back by 512 bytes with eight bytes at a second global address, returning zero on a full match and minus thirty-three on the first mismatch.

name: copy_table_entry_block
description: Searches a table of up to 63 keyed entries for a matching key, then copies a block of words for that entry from a computed source into the destination. It returns zero on success and minus thirty-four when the key is not found.

name: copy_entry_block_by_index
description: Computes a source offset from an entry's fields. When a destination pointer is set it copies a block of words there; otherwise it steps through a sequence of calls and returns zero when all succeed.

name: copy_word_blocks
description: Copies blocks of four words from a source pointer to a destination pointer, advancing both by four words each iteration, for a count set by a register.

name: process_blocks_in_groups
description: Converts a byte count into 512-byte blocks and calls one routine for each group of up to eleven blocks, returning zero when all groups succeed.

name: process_remaining_block_groups
description: Calls one routine for each group of up to eleven units taken from a remaining count, returning zero when the count is used up. On an error result it passes control through an indirect jump whose target could not be recovered.

name: retry_call_until_nonnegative
description: Calls one routine repeatedly while its result is negative. Once the result is non-negative it transfers through an indirect jump whose target could not be recovered.

name: loop_until_nonnegative_result
description: Repeats a call while its result is negative. When the result is non-negative it transfers through an unrecovered indirect jump, otherwise it returns the stored result.

name: return_immediately
description: Consists only of a return instruction, so calling it does nothing.

name: return_without_action
description: Consists only of a return instruction, so calling it does nothing.

name: set_three_globals_conditionally
description: When a register byte ORed with a fixed mask is non-negative, sets three global values to zero, 253 and 16. Otherwise it leaves them unchanged.

name: step_value_toward_target
description: Stores a target word through a pointer, optionally halves it and records a parity bit in a global, then calls one routine repeatedly to step the stored value toward the target. It returns minus fourteen when a routine reports failure.

name: store_and_step_value
description: Stores a word through a pointer, optionally halves it and records a parity bit in a global, then calls one routine while the value is nonzero. It returns minus fourteen on failure.

name: call_while_nonzero_or_fail
description: Calls one routine repeatedly while the value it returns in a data register is nonzero. It returns zero when that value reaches zero and minus fourteen when the sign flag is set on a call.

name: repeat_call_until_zero
description: Calls one routine repeatedly while the value it returns in a data register is nonzero. It returns zero when that value reaches zero and minus fourteen when the sign flag is set on a call.

name: toggle_port_bits_and_call
description: Calls two routines, toggles bit seven of a global port-state value and also bit one when bit four was set, calls one more routine, and returns zero.

name: toggle_bit_seven_and_call
description: Calls two routines, toggles bit seven of a global port-state value, calls one more routine, and returns zero.

name: toggle_when_bit_two_set
description: When bit two of a global value is set, calls one routine, toggles bit seven, calls another routine and returns zero. Otherwise it returns minus fourteen.

name: toggle_ciab_bit_seven
description: Calls one routine, toggles bit seven of a global port-state value, calls another routine and returns zero.

name: toggle_bits_when_flagged
description: If bit two of a global value is set, calls one routine, toggles bits one and seven of a global port-state value, calls another routine and returns zero. Otherwise it returns minus fourteen.

name: toggle_bits_and_call
description: Calls one routine, toggles bits one and seven of a global port-state value, calls another routine and returns zero.

name: select_state_and_write_bytes
description: Sets a global to three when it equals the input byte; otherwise it sets it to eighteen and then to the input byte. It then writes four configuration bytes to the same global.

name: write_fixed_timer_configuration
description: Writes a control value, a fixed low byte of three, a zero, and two configuration bytes to the timer register sequence.

name: copy_longword_blocks_after_check
description: Calls one routine when a word differs from a global value and returns early on a negative result. Otherwise it copies 128 longwords from each of several source blocks, selected by a table index, to the destination pointer.

name: copy_longword_blocks_by_index
description: Copies 128 longwords from each of several source blocks, chosen by a table index, to the destination pointer, with no check beforehand.

name: copy_longword_blocks_from_list
description: Copies 128 longwords from each source block named in a pointer list to the destination pointer, for a count held in a register, and returns zero.

name: find_and_verify_disk_sector
description: Searches a buffer for the disk sync word and a sector marker, sums 128 longwords of the sector and compares the checksum with the stored value, recording the sector address on success. It retries a fixed number of times and returns a negative value on failure.

name: wait_and_read_disk_sector
description: Waits for the disk interrupt flag, starts a disk read with a fixed command word, and then runs the same sector search and checksum verification, returning a negative value on failure.

name: retry_disk_sector_read
description: Starts a disk read with a fixed command word and runs the sector search and checksum check, retrying up to a set count and returning minus seven when the sector is not found.

name: read_track_sectors_with_blitter
description: Runs a disk read and a blitter operation over the track buffer, searching for sector markers and verifying each sector's checksum, and returns a negative value on error.

name: verify_track_sector_table
description: Records sector addresses into a table indexed by sector number, searching and verifying each sector while counting retries. It returns zero when the track checks out and a negative value on error.

name: set_error_return_minus_two
description: Sets a global value to 255 and returns minus two.

name: load_boot_file_sectors
description: References the text SUP.boot, writes the display, DMA and interrupt control registers, then loops over disk sector reads and checks, transferring control through a jump entry at the end.

name: apply_xor_run_length_patch
description: Applies the same run-length XOR patch as its neighbours: a decoded byte stream is XORed into code at a base address. The decoder recovered only this section of the routine.

name: decode_lzss_stream
description: Clears a 4096-byte ring window, then decodes an LZSS-style stream: literal bytes are written to the output and the window, while back-references copy earlier window bytes using a position and a length.

name: compare_register_values
description: Compares two register values and returns in either case, leaving all data unchanged.

name: return_immediately
description: Consists only of a return instruction, so calling it does nothing.

name: return_immediately
description: Consists only of a return instruction, so calling it does nothing.

name: setup_cia_dma_and_interrupts
description: The decompiler timed out, so only the listed facts are known: a 43-instruction routine at the start of a raw code region that writes the CIA control registers, the interrupt enable register and the DMA control register, and calls six other routines.

name: wait_for_interrupt_request
description: The decompiler timed out, so only the listed facts are known: a six-instruction routine that reads and writes the interrupt request registers and is called from a small stub.

name: write_potgo_register
description: The decompiler timed out, so only the listed facts are known: a three-instruction routine that touches the potentiometer control register and is called from a small stub.

name: invoke_two_subroutines
description: The decompiler timed out, so only the listed facts are known: a 19-instruction routine that calls two other routines and is called from three places.

name: invoke_one_subroutine
description: The decompiler timed out, so only the listed facts are known: a three-instruction routine that calls one other routine and is called from two places.

name: read_keyboard_serial_register
description: The decompiler timed out, so only the listed facts are known: a 13-instruction routine that accesses the keyboard serial data register and its control register, and is called from one place.

name: read_joystick_and_mouse_ports
description: The decompiler timed out, so only the listed facts are known: a 74-instruction routine that reads the joystick and mouse movement registers, the fire-button port and the potentiometer button register, and is called from one place.
